title: REQ · game vitest config resolves @game so BootScene can be imported from game/tests
summary: Config alias lets game/tests import the frontend BootScene
description: Context: BootScene.ts imports from '@game/...' and game/vitest.config.ts has no alias, so game/tests cannot import it. Desired behavior: add the @game alias pointing at game/src, the minimal strictly needed change. Expected result: preload.test.ts imports BootScene without resolution errors. Why: BootScene tests must live in game/tests.
acceptance_criteria: Given game/vitest.config.ts, when its resolve.alias is read, then '@game' maps to the game/src directory
Given the config, when tests/**/*.test.ts is matched, then preload.test.ts is included
technical_constraints: Only the alias is added; no new dependencies
